description: This file contains tests for various helper functions related to Tailnet addresses, including detection of IPv4 ranges, listing network interface addresses, and selecting primary addresses. It uses the Vitest testing framework and imports functions from tailnet.js.

methods.name: afterEach
methods.description: Sets up teardown logic after each test to restore mocks.

methods.name: describe
methods.description: Defines a test suite for tailnet helpers.

methods.name: vi.restoreAllMocks
methods.description: Restores all mocked functions to their original implementations.

methods.name: vi.spyOn
methods.description: Creates a spy on an object method to mock its implementation.
